title: Black Light Physical Gravity and Curvature Environment Registry
purpose: Define SI-unit physical environment quantities and validity boundaries that feed family-specific transit penalties. It separates real weak-field/relativistic physics from fictional family coupling and gameplay calibration.

potential.use: Use relative to a declared reference, normally asymptotic infinity for an isolated system or a route/reference point for local navigation. Absolute Newtonian potential is not a general-coordinate invariant in GR.

dimensionlessPotentialDepth.use: Primary weak-field validity indicator and gravitational time-dilation scale.

acceleration.use: Local coordinate acceleration in the selected weak-field frame. A freely falling craft can have near-zero proper acceleration while still experiencing strong tides.

tidalTensor.model: T_ij = sum_a G M_a (3 n_i n_j - delta_ij)/r_a^3
tidalTensor.use: Hessian-derived differential gravity. Its eigenvectors/eigenvalues are the physically relevant local stretching/compression directions for gravitational-plane and structural hazard work.

tidalFrobenius.use: Coordinate-frame scalar norm for engineering comparison in a declared orthonormal local frame; not a full spacetime curvature invariant.

schwarzschildRadius.use: Compactness reference for an isolated nonrotating source. Point-mass weak-field models should be rejected as r/r_s approaches unity.

kretschmann.use: Exact vacuum curvature invariant for a single Schwarzschild source. Multi-body K is not obtained by summing individual K values; registry/runtime therefore reports the maximum per-source value only as a conservative local compactness/curvature indicator.

lenseThirring.model: Omega_LT = 2 G J / (c^2 r^3) in the weak-field axial approximation
lenseThirring.use: Optional frame-dragging estimate when source angular momentum is known. It is not inferred from mass alone.

validity.weakFieldCriterion: epsilon_Phi << 1 and r/r_s >> 1 for every source materially contributing to a point-mass packet.
validity.slowMotionCriterion: Source velocities should be small compared with c unless a post-Newtonian or numerical-relativity model replaces this packet.
validity.extendedBodyCriterion: Do not evaluate a point-mass field inside a source's declared physical radius; use an interior/extended-body model or mark OUTSIDE_MODEL_VALIDITY.
validity.multiBodyCurvatureCriterion: Potential, acceleration and Newtonian tidal tensors may be linearly superposed in the weak-field approximation. Exact GR curvature invariants may not be linearly superposed.
validity.electromagneticCriterion: Magnetic fields, plasma density and radiation can dominate sensor and material behavior but are separate environmental channels; do not disguise them as gravitational curvature.

safetyBridge.potentialMagnitude: Use |Delta Phi| or epsilon_Phi with a declared reference; do not use an unreferenced absolute potential as a universal invariant.
safetyBridge.accelerationMagnitude: Use |g| only as a coordinate-frame environment quantity; never substitute it for tidal loading.
safetyBridge.tidalTensorNorm: Use ||T||_F or a specified eigenvalue metric in a declared local frame.
safetyBridge.curvatureNorm: Use exact/validated relativistic curvature when available. Under the weak-field point-source packet, maxSingleSourceKretschmannPerM4 is a reference indicator, not the exact multi-body curvature invariant.
safetyBridge.uncertainty: Mass, ephemeris, clock, registration and model uncertainty remain independent covariance terms. Missing uncertainty is not zero.
safetyBridge.normalization: Quantities with unlike dimensions may enter one severity score only after explicit division by versioned reference scales. Reference scales are calibration, not physical constants.

familyInterpretation.metric-compression: Prioritize spacetime curvature, tidal gradients, envelope boundary residuals and horizon/closure geometry. Strong curvature is not equivalent to high coordinate acceleration.
familyInterpretation.gravitational-plane: Prioritize the tidal tensor eigensystem, its spatial/temporal derivatives, barycentric topology and uncertainty in hidden masses. A lane fork is modeled as competing admissible eigendirection/route basins, not as a literal material rail splitting in space.
familyInterpretation.slipstream-shear: Use ordinary gravity/curvature as boundary conditions on the normal-space/Q correspondence model; the exotic coupling remains fictional/derived.
familyInterpretation.q-lattice: Ordinary gravity influences clocks, ephemerides, reference state and endpoint covariance; address-space operator physics remains fictional/derived.
familyInterpretation.n-manifold: Ordinary curvature constrains embedding/return maps but does not establish the higher-dimensional metric by itself.
familyInterpretation.fold-jump: Curvature and endpoint tidal state enter precommit endpoint admissibility. Equivalent c is not local hull velocity.
familyInterpretation.wormhole-gate: External tidal loading and mouth synchronization are ordinary physical boundary conditions; exotic stress-energy supporting a traversable throat remains fictional/derived unless named canon specifies it.
familyInterpretation.phase-displacement: Ordinary gravity contributes clock/reference and target-state covariance; macroscopic displacement operator physics remains fictional/derived.
familyInterpretation.inertial-torch: Use ordinary relativistic trajectory, proper acceleration, collision horizon, radiation and thermal physics; no exotic de-transit operator exists.

canonGuards: Real equations used for environmental context do not prove that any fictional FTL family is physically realizable.
Do not assign fictional stress-energy tensors, negative energy densities, coupling constants or superluminal solutions as REAL_PHYSICS.
Do not add potential, acceleration, tides and curvature numerically until each term has been normalized by an explicit reference scale.
Do not treat coordinate acceleration as proper acceleration or as tidal stress.
Do not linearly sum Schwarzschild Kretschmann scalars and call the result an exact multi-body curvature invariant.
Do not infer angular momentum or frame dragging from mass alone.
Do not convert missing covariance, missing mass or missing ephemeris information into zero uncertainty.
Named race/manufacturer/vessel limits outrank this generic environment model within their documented scope.
